usda_fdc_live_check.interpretation: USDA FDC has both raw and cooked candidates. Search results alone do not prove a photographed prepared ingredient is equivalent to a raw 100 g record. The current Foundation record is distinct from the SR Legacy-derived CNF values.

project_pipeline_check.local_usda_dataset: FNDDS 2021-2023; not the complete online FoodData Central corpus
project_pipeline_check.local_dataset_literal_name_screen: No bok choy, pak-choi, Chinese cabbage, or 青江菜 text hit in the checked USDA JSON; this is a literal screen, not a full compatibility proof.
project_pipeline_check.candidate_search_gate: FDC candidate search is restricted to eligible high-confidence, validation-clean specific identities that return a true local no-mapping result.
project_pipeline_check.generic_identity: Generic leafy-green labels such as 炒菜葉 are rejected before FDC search.
project_pipeline_check.query_normalization: The server-owned English alias allowlist includes 糯米腸 only; 青江菜 has no English alias and the generated query plan contains only 青江菜.
project_pipeline_check.route_confirmation: FDC Search returns candidate metadata only; candidate selection is not accepted automatically and the existing flow requires user confirmation before Detail/preview.
project_pipeline_check.feature_flag_code_defaults: FDC candidate, confirmation, Detail, preview, accept and enrichment flags default false in backend/app.py; runtime environment was not inspected.
project_pipeline_check.live_query_result: The official FDC API returned no records for exact Chinese query 青江菜 and returned raw bok-choy records for English query bok choy.

recommended_layering: USDA local FNDDS, followed by the existing user-confirmed USDA FoodData Central candidate/Detail/preview path for true local misses
Tavily retrieval plus constrained model extraction only after a specific food identity is established and no compatible admitted TFDA/USDA record exists
architecture_decision.next_engineering_gate: Add a narrowly server-allowlisted English retrieval alias for 青江菜, test that it finds the raw FDC candidate without relaxing the generic-name gate, then verify cooked-versus-raw compatibility and the reference-only presentation before any Tavily/model nutrition extraction.
architecture_decision.portion_rule: Raw per-100-g nutrition cannot be multiplied by image-estimated cooked grams as an exact cooked-portion result. Label raw ingredient reference values as such or require a compatible cooked record; do not include added oil.

review_limits: This is a technical source and pipeline review, not legal advice or source admission.
The CNF comparison was limited to selected core nutrient fields; the data values themselves were not retained in this evidence record.
A literal local dataset text screen is not a substitute for executing the complete local compatibility matcher against a real scan context.
No photographed-food identity, model confidence calibration, cooked-serving weight, or nutrition accuracy was validated.
The USDA FDC DEMO_KEY has lower rate limits than a registered key; this isolated read is not a production quota test.
